free_tier.stated: Free plan, USD 0: 10,000 API calls a month at up to 10 requests a second, with real-time weather data, basic forecasting and daily forecasts for 5 days; no historical weather.
free_tier.notes: Each call counts as one request whatever it returns; the X-API-CURRENT and X-API-QUOTA response headers report the month's count and limit, and error code 105 answers once the allowance is reached. Bulk path: none on Free; each call returns one location by latitude and longitude, and the hourly Historical API (start and end timestamps) is on Plus (1 year) and Business (5 years) only. The next plan up is Starter at USD 20 a month for 500,000 calls a month.

retention.stated: not applicable: the unit is a request

interface_detail: REST over HTTPS at api.weatherxu.com/v1/weather (current conditions, hourly and daily forecasts) and, on Plus and Business, historical.weatherxu.com/v1/history; the key goes in the api_key query parameter or the X-API-KEY header; JSON answers
tooling: any HTTP client; open-source SDKs on GitHub for Python, JavaScript, Ruby and more, and a Postman collection
chaining: A small keyed forecast source: current conditions and a 5-day daily forecast per latitude and longitude at 10,000 calls a month, with no history on the Free plan.

limits.value: 10,000 API calls a month on the Free plan; error code 105 answers once the allowance is reached
10 requests a second (600 requests a minute) on the Free plan; over it the API answers HTTP 429

binding_note: The monthly allowance is the ceiling a steady poller meets first; the per-second limit only shapes bursts.

identity_cost.detail: The sign-up form lists a full name, an email and a password (8 characters or more with upper-case, lower-case and a number) and acceptance of the terms; the pricing and FAQ pages say no credit card is required, and the API key is issued after the email is verified.

reliability_note: api.weatherxu.com answered HTTP 525 (the CDN's TLS handshake with the origin failed) and historical.weatherxu.com HTTP 522 on every probe between 10:39 and 15:21 UTC on 2026-11-02, from several networks, while the website answered 200 and the status page showed all services operational; over the limits the API answers HTTP 429 or error code 105.
confidence_note: Plan, limits, error codes and sign-up fields are read from first-party pages. The API host answered HTTP 525 on every probe, so the free key was not exercised and no keyless API answer was read; a call with a free key would move this to measured.
